# MoveMyTodo

> MoveMyTodo is a browser-based tool for people leaving Microsoft To Do, which Microsoft retires on June 30, 2027. It signs in to Microsoft with read-only access, shows every list and task, downloads a free backup (CSV, Markdown, JSON, printable page) and moves lists, steps, notes and due dates to Google Tasks, Apple Reminders (Mac import script), Things 3 or Todoist (CSV). Tasks are processed in the browser and never stored on its servers. Backup is free; moving more than 25 tasks costs $6.99 once. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

## Microsoft To Do retirement: key facts (checked 26 November 2026)
- Announced: November 18, 2026, in a Microsoft Planner blog post and the To Do transition guide.
- Shutdown date: June 30, 2027. The To Do apps stop working on web, Windows, Mac, iOS and Android.
- Personal accounts: Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live and Microsoft 365 Personal or Family get no replacement. Microsoft says to choose another task app.
- Work or school accounts: Moved to Planner (“My tasks” is being redesigned from December 2026). Existing To Do tasks and lists are not migrated into it; they stay visible in Planner until June 30, 2027.
- Microsoft's export: Promised before the shutdown, but not available as of 26 November 2026. Microsoft hasn't said what format it will use, and says an export doesn't mean another app can import it.
- Your data: Retiring the apps doesn't by itself schedule your task data for deletion, but there will be no app to see it in.
- What reads To Do today: Microsoft Graph, the official API that apps like MoveMyTodo use with your permission. It will also be retired later; no date yet.

## What moves where
- Lists: Google Tasks: New list each; Apple Reminders (Mac): New list each; Things 3: Project each; Free CSV / Markdown: Column / heading
- Steps: Google Tasks: Subtasks; Apple Reminders (Mac): Checklist in notes; Things 3: Checklist items; Free CSV / Markdown: Kept
- Notes and links: Google Tasks: Kept; Apple Reminders (Mac): Kept; Things 3: Kept; Free CSV / Markdown: Kept
- Due dates: Google Tasks: Kept (date only); Apple Reminders (Mac): Kept; Things 3: Deadline; Free CSV / Markdown: Kept
- Reminder times: Google Tasks: Written into notes; Apple Reminders (Mac): Kept; Things 3: “When” + time; Free CSV / Markdown: Kept
- Repeating tasks: Google Tasks: Written into notes; Apple Reminders (Mac): Written into notes; Things 3: Written into notes; Free CSV / Markdown: Kept as text + rule
- Important / flagged: Google Tasks: Noted with ★; Apple Reminders (Mac): Flag + priority; Things 3: “Important” tag; Free CSV / Markdown: Kept
- Completed tasks: Google Tasks: Marked done; Apple Reminders (Mac): Marked done; Things 3: Logged; Free CSV / Markdown: Kept with date
- File attachments: Google Tasks: Not moved; Apple Reminders (Mac): Not moved; Things 3: Not moved; Free CSV / Markdown: Listed only

## Pages
- [Tool: move Microsoft To Do to Google Tasks or Apple Reminders](https://movemytodo.com/)
- [How to move Microsoft To Do to Google Tasks](https://movemytodo.com/microsoft-to-do-to-google-tasks/): Google Tasks has no import button. Move every Microsoft To Do list to Google Tasks with steps as subtasks, notes and due dates, in about two minutes.
- [How to move Microsoft To Do to Apple Reminders](https://movemytodo.com/microsoft-to-do-to-apple-reminders/): Move Microsoft To Do lists into Apple Reminders with notes, due dates and reminder times. A one-command Mac import, plus a free method for iPhone.
- [How to export Microsoft To Do (free)](https://movemytodo.com/export-microsoft-to-do/): Microsoft To Do has no export button and Microsoft's promised export isn't out yet. Download every list, step and due date as CSV, Markdown, JSON or a printable page.
- [Microsoft To Do is shutting down: what to do now](https://movemytodo.com/microsoft-to-do-shutting-down/): Microsoft To Do retires June 30, 2027 and nothing migrates automatically. Key dates, what happens to your tasks, and how to back up and move them.
- [How to move Microsoft To Do to Things 3](https://movemytodo.com/microsoft-to-do-to-things-3/): Things 3 can't import Microsoft To Do. Move each To Do list into a Things project with steps as checklist items, due dates as deadlines and notes intact, on Mac, iPhone or iPad.
- [Microsoft To Do alternatives, compared by how your tasks get there](https://movemytodo.com/microsoft-to-do-alternatives/): Microsoft To Do retires June 30, 2027. Compare Todoist, TickTick, Superlist, Google Tasks, Apple Reminders, Things 3 and Planner by how your existing lists get there.
